source_review.author: Lance Ship; pattern data by Emilie Gillet
source_review.description: Three-channel 32-step rhythm sequencer that bilinearly interpolates a two-dimensional pattern map. X and Y move between related grooves, three densities reveal progressively more events, chaos perturbs thresholds once per pattern, and accents mark the strongest events. Uses GPL-3.0-or-later pattern data derived from Grids. Tags: sequencer, rhythm, drum, topographic, density, chaos, accent, seedable.

source_review.author: Lance Ship; DSP by Emilie Gillet
source_review.description: Complete 24-engine Plaits macro voice with main and auxiliary outputs, internal trigger envelope and low-pass gate, optional drone and external-level modes, and modulation of pitch, harmonics, timbre, and morph. Engines 0-7 are the later virtual-analog-filter, phase-distortion, six-operator FM, wave-terrain, string-machine, and chiptune additions; engines 8-23 are the original tonal, noise, physical, and percussion models. Tags: synthesis, macro-voice, 24-engine, speech, FM, physical-model, percussion, Plaits-DSP, very-heavy.
